snippet.title: JAILBREAK - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
An asymmetric PvP prison escape game for up to 8 players, where prisoners loot, craft, and scheme their
way to freedom while the guard tries to shut the whole mess down. Work together, make bad decisions, and
do whatever it takes to break out.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3426310/Jailbreak/
